_about: Streetcars and buses (engine/fetch_surface.py, engine/surface.py). 'gtfs' says where the agency's schedule comes from: a CKAN package (ckan) or a direct zip (url). 'skip' lists route numbers already drawn by another layer (Subway & LRT). 'feeds' adds other agencies, each fetched into raw/surface/<feed>/: GO buses keep their own mode ('go') and a 'GO ' prefix so GO 41 never collides with TTC 41; they get no families (frequent, express...), which describe the TTC network.
